title: SBH-40 Trip Hi-Viz Yellow

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tuned for all-terrain exploration, the Steelbird SBH-40 Trip Hi-Viz Yellow is bridges highway aerodynamic poise with high-flow off-road ventilation across highway asphalt and backcountry gravel. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at 1425g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~91 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Budget adventure helmet with removable peak and dual visor.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for Adventure/Dual Sport use; features extended rear coverage and adjustable visor compatibility.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Steelbird SBH-40 Trip Hi-Viz Yellow: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Steelbird's Adventure / Dual Sport lineup, the SBH-40 Trip Hi-Viz Yellow brings Indian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Steelbird SBH-40 Trip Hi-Viz Yellow represents Steelbird's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~91 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Adventure / Dual Sport helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Steelbird SBH-40 Trip Hi-Viz Yellow delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
